      "binary_exe_windows": "llama-server.exe",
      "binary_exe_linux": "llama-server",
      "arch": "gfx1151",
      "tracked": true,
      "notes": "Lemonade nightly ROCm channel. Built via TheRock SDK. Not upstreamed."
    },
    {
      "fork_id": "llamacpp-rocm-stable",

      "arch": "gfx1151",

    },
    {

      "label": "llama.cpp gfx11 (AMD-Ecosystem)",
      "recipe": "llamacpp",
      "backend": "rocm-gfx11",
      "install_as": "rocm",
      "rocm_channel": "nightly",
      "repo": "AMD-Ecosystem/llama.cpp",
      "branch": "gfx11",
      "version_source": "github_latest",
      "version_tag_prefix": "gfx11-rocm-nightly-",
      "binary_url_windows": "",
      "binary_url_linux": "https://github.com/AMD-Ecosystem/llama.cpp/releases/download/{version}/llama-{version}-ubuntu-rocm-multiarch-x64.tar.gz",
      "binary_exe_windows": "",
      "binary_exe_linux": "llama-server",
      "runner_os": "linux",
      "arch": "gfx1151",
      "tracked": true,
      "notes": "Nightly dated builds. Tag format: gfx11-rocm-nightly-YYYYMMDD. Single multiarch binary — covers all RDNA3/3.5 targets. Linux only, no Windows binary. Runs on Linux ROCm self-hosted runner."

    {

      "binary_exe_windows": "llama-server.exe",

      "arch": "gfx1151",
      "tracked": true,
